$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/_core.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`; scripts/factory/check-ownership.mjs and check-policy-parity.mjs check it. keyColumns: the column each policy key is compared on. access: role -> privileges, scopedBy (keys beyond the tenant wall), hiddenColumns (neither read nor written). No role deletes master data here: it is archived. The partner role has no core table yet; the partner wall step decides what the portal reads.

Tenant.about: Platform table. factory_platform lists and creates tenants (sign-in lookups before a tenant is known, tenant set-up); office and floor sessions read their own tenant's row (its name and default locale).

Company.about: Office keeps the legal entities. The floor reads names, address and logo (labels printed at a station carry the manufacturer), not the fiscal identifiers, the share capital or the bank account (written by the office only with a step-up; deposit pages and documents read it in the system scope).

Site.about: Office keeps the sites; a floor device reads only its own site.

Line.about: Office keeps the lines; a floor device reads the lines of its site.

WorkCentre.about: Office keeps the work centres; a floor device reads those of its site.

Station.about: Office keeps the stations; a floor device reads the stations of its site.
